One approach, two kinds of work

01FREIGHT FORWARDING

Freight Forwarding Customer Service Assistant

Spend less time switching between systems and miss fewer follow-ups. See what changed, what needs attention and why.

  • Bring together authorized shipment updates and surface changes and open follow-ups.
  • Show what needs checking when a key detail is missing, and why it matters before responding.
  • Suggest a next step or draft a reply from confirmed information. Staff review it, make any edits and decide whether to send it.
  • Keep the evidence: every lookup, check and draft keeps its timestamp and source. Under the FMC rule, a D&D bill leaves you a 30-calendar-day window to dispute — a clean record is what you bring.

Sample follow-up card (synthetic)

No confirmed date
A shipment update does not include a confirmed date, so there is no date to promise.
Response draft
We’re checking the date and will update you once it’s confirmed.
Status
Draft only. Awaiting staff review; not sent.

ISF countdown (synthetic example)

Vessel
VESSEL ZZ
Est. lading
NOV 26
Filing deadline
24 hours before lading
Status
Documents pending · not filed

Synthetic example: not a live run. ISF must be filed electronically via ABI/ACE (per U.S. CBP). We draft, check and watch deadlines; we do not file. Source：19 CFR § 113.62.

02MEDICAL RESEARCH & INTELLIGENCE

Medical Literature & Intelligence Assistant

Go beyond alerts about new papers. See what new evidence may change and trace each conclusion to its source. The same harness, a different domain — built on the same governed pipeline.

  • Track approved literature, guideline publishers and study registries by topic.
  • Compare with previous briefs. Flag conclusions that may need updating, those that remain unchanged and questions still open. Keep the source link, publication date and relevant passage.
  • Researchers verify the sources and the strength of the evidence before updating the brief. For research and intelligence, not clinical advice.

Sample evidence alert (synthetic)

New item
A new public study appeared on a tracked topic. Only the abstract has been reviewed.
Evidence limit
The abstract alone does not establish a change in recommendations.
Next step
Check the full text and methods before deciding whether to update the brief.

FROM DESIGN TO DELIVERY

How it runs

  1. 01

    Agree on the task

    Bring a workflow example without sensitive details. We agree on the inputs, sources, access and what needs human review.

  2. 02

    Install and run locally

    Install the runner on a supported computer or workstation, then configure the workflow and tools. Run it manually or on an agreed schedule where supported, using only authorized sources.

  3. 03

    Review the output and its evidence

    See the brief or draft, run log and source evidence in the agreed local interface or approved channel. Uncertain or failed items go to a person. External sends follow the agreed rules.

What you receive

You receive a configured local workflow, output templates, and run and review records. We verify the setup together using agreed samples.
